title: Half Heart mode
description: Hardcore Forge mod for Minecraft 1.8.9 with permanent 1 HP and no regeneration.
body:
Half Heart Mod is a hardcore mod for Minecraft 1.8.9 that leaves the player with only half a heart (1 HP).

=The /hpone command activates a survival mode with permanent 1 HP even if the player dies in the world.

=The mod completely disables all health regeneration, works even on Peaceful difficulty, and adds cool activation messages on screen with a reference to a famous movie series.

=The mod works on Forge for Minecraft 1.8.9.

=There may be updates for newer versions up to 1.20.5, where Mojang added the ability to set 1 HP using commands.

✔The command currently requires cheats enabled or LAN mode!!

Stay tuned for updates :)
